tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.1:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-primary-purple
tokens.usage: #3b82f6 (Purple to Blue). Used as text on `.btn-primary`, `.content-card-action`, `.table-amount`. 4.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-primary-blue
tokens.usage: #3b82f6 (Purple to Blue). Used as text on `.content-card-action:hover`, `.badge-series-b`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-dark
tokens.usage: Professional depth, data credibility. Used as text on `body`, `.section-title`, `.stat-value`. 17.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Clarity, modern minimalism, breathability. Used as text on `.header`, `.header-brand`, `.header-nav a`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-300
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-400
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-period`, `.footer-description`, `.footer-links a`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-600
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.data-table th`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Growth metrics, positive change. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.badge-seed`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-change-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.stat-change.negative`; text on `.stat-change.negative`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
